title: 7-Year Treasury Note auction (December new issue) — a Tuesday for year-end, settling on the last business day of 2026
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) and its text layer decompressed stream-by-stream by the treasury-7y-note-2026-11-25 initial research. Row reads `7-Year NOTE Thursday, December 24, 2026 Tuesday, December 29, 2026 Thursday, December 31, 2026` with NO trailing `R`, so a new issue — as every 7-Year in the record is (259 rows on `security_term`, zero reopenings). 1:00pm ET is Treasury's standing coupon-auction convention and is NOT separately sourced here: `closing_time_comp` reads 11:30 AM only on SIFMA early-close sessions, and 2026-12-29 is not one — but 2026-12-24 (its announcement) and 2026-12-31 (its settlement) both are. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the 2026-12-24 announcement. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED 2026-09-09 by the treasury-7y-note-2026-11-25 never-assessed initial research — its own direct successor, and the reason it is filed despite sitting 34 days outside the proposer's five-day corridor (the treasury-7y-note-2026-10-29 sibling explicitly declined to file it on corridor grounds, and that reasoning is not wrong, only differently weighted here). THE REASON IT EARNS A ROW NOW: the proposing research retired the inherited claim that the 7-Year auction carries a fixed −0.95bp 7Y-minus-10Y signature — reproduced exactly on its 2023-onward window, it REVERSES SIGN out of sample (2014–2021: +0.479bp, t = +3.98) and pools to nothing over 152 auctions (−0.079bp, t = −0.66). What replaced it is a model, `7s10s = −1.894 + 0.090 × dealer%` (slope t = 7.83, partial corr controlling for time +0.349 t = 4.55, year-demeaned slope +0.082 t = 3.83), and a model needs out-of-sample prints to be scored against. 2026-12-29 is the second of them after 2026-11-25 (FT-treasury-7y-note-2026-11-25-1 scores the first), which is a research dependency the corridor rule does not see. WHAT IS STRUCTURALLY DISTINCT ABOUT THE DECEMBER SLOT: the weekday is a year-end displacement, not a holiday one — in the schedule's Aug-2026-to-Jan-2027 window the 7-Year auctions on a THURSDAY in four of six months (08-27, 09-24, 10-29, 2027-01-28); November is Wednesday for Thanksgiving and December is Tuesday for year-end. The auction itself is a full session, but it is BRACKETED by two SIFMA early closes — its announcement (2026-12-24, tracked as christmas-eve-half-day-2026-12-24) and its settlement (2026-12-31, tracked as sifma-bond-early-close-2026-12-31) — and it settles on the last business day of the year, which is a balance-sheet-date fact the November auction's 11-30 settlement is not. SIZE EXPECTATION $44B, unchanged at every 7-Year since 2024-04-25 and identical in all six monthly rows sb0590 publishes; the December cell is set at the 2026-11-04 refunding.
